messages:
sarah: FYI we changed the structured output format for function/tool-calls to include an explicit \"schema_version\" field. Need a 2-sentence release note, a tiny SDK migration snippet, and a known-issue blurb about JSON-escaping in older clients. Target deploy tomorrow morning.
pete: Put a draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456 - added release blurb at /releases/structured-output and a short example. PTAL.
li: Quick note: old outputs were just raw JSON returned in text; new envelope is {"schema_version":"v2","result":{...}}. This breaks naive JSON parse-on-text code.
li: Example old vs new:
```json
// old
{"response": {"name":"x","age":30}}
// new
{"schema_version":"v2","result":{"response":{"name":"x","age":30}},"meta":{"model":"tool-1"}}
```
marta: Recommend we add SDK helper example and a one-liner migration for curl users. Also flag that some clients that did string.replace to fix quotes will corrupt the envelope.
sarah: Agreed. Pete can you add the SDK helper snippet showing .unwrap_response() and a curl parse example using jq? Keep tiny.
pete: Added this Python snippet to PR:
```python
# SDK >=0.10.0 helper to unwrap new envelope
res = client.tools.call(...)
payload = res.unwrap_response()
# payload is the original object clients expect
```
pete: And a curl example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools -d '{"input":"..."}' | jq '.result.response'
```
li: Also included a known-issue line: "Old clients that assume raw JSON in the top-level text may see duplicated escapes or invalid JSON; upgrade SDK or parse the envelope." Added a tiny repro note in PR.
marta: Can we add a short diagnostic snippet that shows the broken pattern so support can triage quickly? One line showing a common bad pattern would help.
sarah: Sure, keep it one line. Pete can append.
pete: Added to PR under troubleshooting:
```js
// broken: naive replace on text will mangle envelope
text.replace('\\\"','\"')  // BAD
```
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1456--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/structured-output). Link-check passed.
li: Tiny wording nit: call out that schema_version is backwards-compatible for now but may add fields in v2+; added a parenthetical to the blurb.
pete: Updated the blurb accordingly. Also shortened changelog sentence for the top-level release notes.
marta: Can reviewers react with :shipit: if no further nits? Want to merge after CI.
sarah: :shipit: I checked the preview and examples render OK.
li: :shipit: added one more test note in PR comments about embed parsing.
docs-ci: Final build green. Merged and scheduled site deploy at 07:00.
sarah: Thanks team. I'll add the release bullet to the internal release tracker and ping product for the announcement. Closing thread. :tada:
